verses.1: And I saw that when the ram opened one of the seven locks, I heard a voice from among the four animals say, “Come.”
verses.2: And I saw also a white horse. The man sitting on that horse was armed with a sword. He was given flowers as a reward for his victory. And he went away, ready to win more battles.
verses.3: And when he opened the second lock, I heard the second animal say, “Come.”
verses.4: And another red horse came out. To the one who sat on it, it was given the authority to bring peace upon the earth, and to make them destroy each other. It also was given to him a large sword.
verses.5: And when he opened the third lock, I heard the third animal say, “Come.” And we saw that it was a black horse. And the man sitting on it had a load in his hands.
verses.6: And I heard a voice saying among the four animals: “For the fish, three denarii; and for the three kinds of meat, also three denarii. And do not waste any oil or wine.”
verses.7: And when he opened the fourth seal, I heard a voice from the fourth animal say, “Come.”
verses.8: And I saw that there was also a horse. The man sitting on that horse’s back had the name “Death”. The devil followed behind him. They were given authority over the fourth part of the earth: to die in rivers, lakes, and other places. They were also subject to the dangers posed by various creatures on earth.
verses.9: And when they opened the fifth seal, we saw below the altar the souls of those who had been sacrificed, because of the word of God and because of the testimony they possessed.
verses.10: And they cried out in a loud voice, saying, “When will you, O holy and righteous ruler, not judge and punish the blood that is shed on this land by those who live here?”
verses.11: And to each of them was given a white robe. They were also told to rest for a little while longer, until they could pay off their debts, just as their relatives and brothers who would be killed in the future would also have to do so.
verses.12: And we saw when he opened the second lock. A great earthquake occurred, and the sun became dark like a furry cloak. The moon also became like blood.
verses.13: And the stars of the sky fell to the earth. Just as a vine drops its seeds into the wind, so too did they fall under the force of a strong wind.
verses.14: And the sky was torn apart, becoming a book. All mountains and islands were also destroyed from their places.
verses.15: And the kings of the land, as well as the nobles, the rulers, the rich men, the powerful, and every slave and free man, all hid themselves in the caves and in the caves of the mountains.
verses.16: And they say to the mountains and rocks: “Fall on us! Hide us from the sight of those who sit on the throne. Also, hide us from the anger of the bull.”
verses.17: For the day of their great anger had come; who could stand against it?
